info.title: API.SH: Rappi
info.description: The Rappi API from API.SH: public Rappi data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The option groups of one menu item (the items marked `has_options` in /rappi/v1/restaurant): each group's id, name, type (one choice or several), minimum and maximum choices and whether a choice is required, and its options with id, name, price, base price, maximum quantity, availability, suggested flag and image; plus the item's upselling groups. `groups` is empty when the item has no options.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rappi-product-options

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The restaurant's rappi.com.*/restaurantes/<id>-<name> link.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Restaurant id (with country) instead of url.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: br (default), co, mx, ar, cl, pe, uy, ec or cr.

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: A product `id` from the restaurant's menu (/rappi/v1/restaurant sections).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Rappi restaurant: id, name, brand, link, city, address, coordinates, type, status, available-now and open-today flags, today's hours and the week's opening hours, delivery price, ETA, rating and reviews, cuisines, promotion and offers, busy flags, logo and image, and the full menu: every section with its products: id, name, description, price, list price, discount, availability, popular, has-options and Prime-discount flags, minimum units and image. An item's options (sizes, flavours, toppings) come from /rappi/v1/product-options.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rappi-restaurant

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The restaurant's rappi.com.*/restaurantes/<id>-<name> link (from /rappi/v1/restaurants).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Restaurant id (with country) instead of url.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: br (default), co, mx, ar, cl, pe, uy, ec or cr.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Rappi restaurants in a country's main city
get.description:
The restaurants Rappi's restaurants page shows for a country's main city (Sao Paulo, Bogota, Mexico City, Buenos Aires, Santiago, Lima...): id, name, link, status, next opening, rating, reviews, ETA, delivery cost, free-delivery flag and promotion, new and Prime-exclusive flags, brand id, cuisines, logo and image; the page's carousels (top rated, promotions) and the cuisine list, with the city's restaurant count. `cuisine` narrows the list by cuisine name.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rappi-restaurants

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: br (default), co, mx, ar, cl, pe, uy, ec or cr.

parameters.name: cuisine
parameters.description: Only restaurants with a cuisine containing this (in the country's language, e.g. `pizza`, `hamburguesa`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: The first restaurants of the country's main city as the restaurants page lists them; open one with /rappi/v1/restaurant.

get.description:
Rappi's search across every store that delivers to a location (restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacies, Rappi Mall, pets, express and liquor stores), as the site's search page shows it: each store with id, name, type and section, brand, link, status, open flag, rating, ETA, delivery cost, minimum order, offers (tag, title, value, end date), today's hours and logo, and the store's matching products or dishes (id, name, price, list price, discount, availability, stock, has-options flag, presentation, unit price, category, EAN, age and prescription flags, image). Also the sections the search found results in (for `store_type`) and stores out of delivery range. Without `lat`/`lon` the country's main city is used. The search returns one list (`next_page` is always null); `limit` caps the stores returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rappi-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to search for (a dish, product or store name, in the country's language, e.g. `pizza`, `coca cola`, `hamburguesa`).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: br (default), co, mx, ar, cl, pe, uy, ec or cr.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Delivery location latitude (with `lon`); default the country's main city, e.g. -23.5843 for Sao Paulo.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Delivery location longitude (with `lat`), e.g. -46.6746.

parameters.name: store_type
parameters.description: Only one section of the search: restaurant, market (supermarkets), pharmacy, mall (Rappi Mall), pets, express or liquor, or any `value` from `sections` in a response (sections differ a little by country).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), delivery_price (cheapest delivery first) or delivery_eta (fastest first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores to return (1-100, default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A non-restaurant store on Rappi (supermarket, pharmacy, liquor store and others): id, name, brand, type, classification, neighbourhood, city, delivery price, service fee, delivery time, location, logo, opening hours, notes, its aisles with product counts and the storefront's featured products (price, list price, discount, unit price, presentation, stock, image). With aisle, that aisle's sub-aisles with their first products and counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rappi-store

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Rappi store link (rappi.com.br/lojas/<id>-<name>, or /tiendas/ in other countries), or pass id with country.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The store id (from /rappi/v1/search), instead of url.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code with id: br (default), co, mx, ar, cl, pe, uy, ec, cr.

parameters.name: aisle
parameters.description: An aisle's friendly_url from this route's aisles, for that aisle's products.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
